NewsArticle.Title: Server Reboot
NewsArticle.Content: Dark Ages servers rebooted unexpectedly 6:17-6:36 pm PDT. We isolated and corrected the error within minutes. We apologize for the inconvenience and are creating long-term solutions to this rare problem. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
